paragraphs: Rabbi Yonah Botzraya: Midrash Shmuel 25:2 (cited here as chapter 26), Tanchuma, Tissa, and Jerusalem Talmud, BaKol Mearvin; Nazir, chapter 6; Yoma, chapter 5: Botzrayah. At the end of Beitzah, chapter 2, Mi SheHafakh, and Kilayim, chapter 8. There, chapter 9, he asked before Rabbi Mana. In HaNoder Min HaMevushal: Botzrayya. At the beginning of Bammeh Behemah: Rabbi Yonah ben Tzeruyah; see above, Rabbi Yehudah.
